title: Red Tag Desk Talk
one_liner: A red label tag for the first 4.5 s, small sentence-case captions that hard-swap, and a list card that un-redacts point by point as you say it.
best_for: A list, ladder or framework said straight to camera ('three reasons', 'step two'), 12-40 s.

palette.use: tag text, captions, the list card

pace: Word-tight cut at 1.15x (208 wpm in the demo), captions hard-swap every ~0.7 s, camera locked off with ONE +15% punch-in near the end, no music, no effects
signature_moves: Red Montserrat Black Italic label tag above the head from frame 0, gone hard at 4.5 s
Small one-line Poppins captions, sentence case, one word in bold, hard swaps with no animation
A prop that changes on the spoken beat: a redacted list card clearing point by point plus a violet meter stepping 1/3 -> 2/3, then the prop leaves on one hard punch-in
